name: What maintenance is needed for the interior of a log home?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is needed for the interior of a log home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior log home maintenance typically involves dusting and cleaning the logs, checking for any signs of moisture intrusion, and occasionally re-applying interior sealants or finishes if needed. Maintaining proper humidity levels indoors is also important to prevent logs from drying out and cracking.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior log maintenance includes cleaning, checking for moisture, and maintaining humidity levels.
